characters.name: Isaac Gonzalez
characters.identity: young adult laborer with short black hair, thin black mustache, lean build, worn grey flat cap, brown canvas work jacket over a collarless white shirt, dark trousers with suspenders, scuffed work boots

characters.name: Arthur Jell
characters.identity: middle-aged company treasurer, round wire spectacles, neatly parted greying hair, clean-shaven pale face, dark three-piece wool suit with a gold watch chain, stiff white collar, black tie

characters.name: Hugh Ogden
characters.identity: Colonel Hugh Ogden, distinguished man in his fifties, short grey hair, grey moustache, upright military posture, dark civilian suit with white wing collar, reading glasses in hand

characters.name: George Layhe
characters.identity: Boston firefighter in his thirties, broad shoulders, short brown hair, clean-shaven, dark navy 1910s fire department uniform with brass buttons, black leather fire helmet

characters.name: Bridget Clougherty
characters.identity: 65-year-old Irish-American woman, grey hair pinned in a low bun, kind lined face, ankle-length dark wool skirt, white apron, green knitted shawl over her shoulders
